description: The plot illustrates how a metric labeled “Similarity” varies across model “Layer” for four language-pair conditions shown in the legend (en&en, en&es, en&el, en&bn). The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 23 with tick labels shown every 2 layers (0, 2, 4, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to 0.45 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.05 intervals. Four solid lines without visible point markers are plotted: the en&en series is a dark red line that starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a local peak around 0.26 at layer 6, drops to about 0.16 at layer 7, stays around 0.15–0.18 through roughly layers 9–13, declines to about 0.12–0.13 around layers 15–16, reaches a low near 0.08–0.09 around layers 19–21, then increases sharply to about 0.18 at layer 22 and ends near 0.43 at layer 23. The en&es series is a blue line that begins near 0.06 at layer 0, increases to about 0.24 at layer 6, falls to roughly 0.15 at layer 7, remains around 0.15–0.18 through about layers 9–13, decreases to around 0.11–0.12 by layers 15–16, drops further to about 0.06–0.07 around layers 19–21, then rises to about 0.13 at layer 22 and ends near 0.27 at layer 23. The en&el series is a green line that starts near 0.04 at layer 0, climbs to about 0.15 at layer 6, dips to around 0.10 at layer 7, gradually increases to roughly 0.14–0.15 around layers 12–13, declines to about 0.09 by layers 15–16, reaches around 0.05 near layers 19–21, then rises to about 0.12 at layer 22 and ends near 0.30 at layer 23. The en&bn series is a purple line that begins near 0.03–0.04 at layer 0, rises to about 0.14 at layer 6, drops to around 0.09–0.10 at layer 7, increases to roughly 0.13–0.14 around layers 12–13, declines to about 0.08–0.09 by layers 15–16, reaches about 0.05 around layers 19–21, then increases to about 0.14 at layer 22 and ends near 0.29 at layer 23.
